statements.t: We also completed our New Orleans market banking center relocation project and continued to execute our plan to expand organically.
• We continued to implement our organic expansion plan with the following projects:
◦ In the New Orleans market, we completed our banking center relocation project.
We expect this location to o pen in the first quarter of 2027.
We expect to open this location in the first quarter of 2027 as the Bank’s first full-service banking center location in Slidell and our second in the Northshore market.
“When 2026 began, we expected a slowly decreasing interest rate environment; however, that shifted to a ‘higher for longer’ rate environment during the summer.
In May 2026, we completed the Northwest market relocation project, and in July 2026, we completed the New Orleans downtown move into the Energy Centre Building.
We also recently acquired an existing banking center building in Slidell, Louisiana, which we expect to become our second full-service banking center in the Northshore market.
We look forward to opening both of these locations in the first quarter of 2027.
During the fourth quarter of 2026, we project $93.8 million of fixed rate loans at 5.85% to mature, which we expect to redeploy into loans with higher rates.
We have $529.5 million of floating rate loans at 6.24%, which we expect to reprice slightly higher.

We also expect to receive $24.0 million in securities cash flows at 3.64%, for which we are evaluating reinvestment options as we consider balance sheet management strategies and the forecasted interest rate environment.
We project $190.7 million in time deposits at 3.37% to mature, which we expect to renew at higher rates.
Depending on balance sheet activity, the interest rate environment, and competition, we expect net interest income and net interest margin FTE to increase slightly in the fourth quarter of 2026.
We expect SBIC income or loss to fluctuate in future quarters.
As of September 30, 2026, we had $93.8 million of unfunded construction loan commitments, which we expect to fund over time.

In addition, our actual financial results in the future may differ from those currently expected due to additional risks and uncertainties of which we are not currently aware or which we do not currently view as, but in the future may become, material to our business or operating results.
